t: Router- Black & Decker Plunge Router 2HP
desc:
Perfect Condition - USED ONE WEEK FOR A PROJECT BUT NOT NEEDED.

Black & Decker EVS (Electronic Variable Speed) Plunge Router with 2 HP. Key specifications of this router and general information about routers are:
Horsepower: 2 HP.
Variable Speed: 8,000-24,000 RPM.
Collet Diameter: Accepts both 1/2" and 1/4" shank bits.
Plunge Stroke: 2-1/8".
Depth Stop: Features a 3-stage turret for setting depths.
Motor: 10 Amp.
Weight: 13.5 pounds.
Dust Extraction: Compatible with dust extraction systems.
Usage: Suitable for cutting decorative edges, joints, and other cutouts. Plunge routers are particularly useful for making cuts within the middle of a workpiece, such as mortises or hidden dados.
Router Bit Types:
HSS (high-speed steel) bits for softwood.
TCT (tungsten carbide tipped) bits for hardwood.
Operation: When working on outside edges, move the router counterclockwise; for inside edges, move it clockwise.
Safety: Always ensure the vacuum cleaner is secure and out of the way when using dust extraction. The vacuum hose and power cord should be positioned to avoid interference with the router or workpiece.
Additional Features: Spindle lock for easy bit changes
